explication: Highball is a macOS app and CLI for installing Wine-based engines, creating bottles, applying game recipes, selecting renderers, and launching Steam, Epic, or standalone Windows programs. The principal workflow is user command or UI action → app state orchestration → engine/bottle preparation → recipe and renderer setup → Wine launch → session observation and compatibility reporting. The graph preserves the documented Steam/Epic branches, engine downloads, renderer overlays, progress handling, and open compatibility database; several database and launcher internals were not sampled.
